gloss: to be imminent; to draw near; to press in

definitions.gloss: to be imminent; to draw near; to press close
definitions.explanation: Of a deadline, the year's end, or an event: to be close at hand and pressing. Conveys a sense of mounting urgency as the time approaches.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{押|お}し{迫|せま}ってきた。
examples.english: The end of the year is fast approaching.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{押|お}し{迫|せま}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{押|お}し{迫|せま}り、⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}している→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: With the exam fast approaching, I study late every night.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧); the approaching thing is the subject (⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧).

ASPECT (ている):
- Most often used in the て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ / てくる forms ({押|お}し{迫|せま}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧, {押|お}し{迫|せま}ってきた) to express that the time is now pressing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{押|お}し{迫|せま}る: the year-end is drawing near
- ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{押|お}し{迫|せま}る: the deadline is looming
- ⟦{期限|きげん}→期限：12861_kigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{押|お}し{迫|せま}る: the time limit is approaching
